name: control-atlas
description: Federal cyber guidance is scattered and hard to use. Control Atlas brings the public sources, connections, and starter tools together so the people doing the work can find what they need and keep moving.

scripts.test: npm run test:atlas && npm run test:data && npm run test:runtime && npm run test:graph
scripts.test:correction:local: npm run build:site && playwright test --config playwright.e2e.config.mjs tests/e2e/epic1-atlas-correctness.spec.mjs tests/e2e/navigation-fidelity.spec.mjs tests/e2e/epic5-source-first-records.spec.mjs tests/e2e/epic6-responsive-accessibility.spec.mjs
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:site && npm run test:e2e:run
scripts.test:performance: npm run build:site && node ./node_modules/@lhci/cli/src/cli.js autorun && node ./tools/summarize-lighthouse.mjs
scripts.style:check: npm run copy:extract && node ./tools/run-vale.mjs README.md docs/PRD.md docs/vision.md docs/DESIGN_PRINCIPLES.md artifacts/vale/ui-copy.md
scripts.test:e2e:live:entry: playwright test --config playwright.live.config.mjs tests/e2e/frontend-responsive.spec.mjs --grep "responsive audit: entry and guidance"
scripts.test:e2e:live:catalog: playwright test --config playwright.live.config.mjs tests/e2e/frontend-responsive.spec.mjs --grep "responsive audit: catalog and records"
scripts.test:e2e:live:build: playwright test --config playwright.live.config.mjs tests/e2e/frontend-responsive.spec.mjs --grep "responsive audit: build and resources"
scripts.test:e2e:live:workbench: playwright test --config playwright.live.config.mjs tests/e2e/frontend-responsive.spec.mjs --grep "responsive audit: workbenches and trust"
scripts.test:a11y: npm run build:site && npm run test:a11y:run
scripts.test:a11y:smoke: playwright test --config playwright.a11y.config.mjs --grep "a11y: home|a11y: focused Atlas Map|a11y: Atlas zero connections|a11y: record detail graph list|a11y: learn hub"
scripts.verify:public: npm run check:data-size && npm run smoke:static && npm run audit:coverage
scripts.precommit: npm run build:site && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:browser && npm run smoke:dom && npm run verify:public && npm run test:a11y:smoke && npm run test:e2e:smoke
